notes.title: Approved Mural Design — Grandview Underpass
notes.content:
Final design signed off by the arts council after the community vote.
Palette:
- Sky band: cerulean blue
- Hills: sage green
- River: deep teal
- Lettering: warm ivory
Layout: three sections across the 40-ft retaining wall — Hills, River, Lettering — with the sky band running the full width.
